fclr011_recompute.diagnosis: Independent clean OLS recompute (no LFS panel, no heuristic predictor) does NOT reproduce the sealed FCLR-011 PASS (sealed C2_vs_B1 +4.94%). Observed C2_vs_B1 is strongly negative (C2 worse than B1) because the C2 premium slot is NOT computable from the cached 2026 archive and C2 degrades to C1 + EMA24 distance; adding signed-funding / trailing-|funding| features to the log-RV HAR design materially worsens out-of-sample QLIKE on 2026-05-08..2026-08-06 (C2_vs_B1 -294.01, C1_vs_B1 -342.67, C2_vs_C1 +10.99 pct-points). Genuine reproducibility/integrity finding, not a script failure: the audit runs end-to-end after two implementation defects were fixed. The sealed result is NOT INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED / fragile and never promotable.
